name: Lan
source: After her village was suddenly attacked, she lost both her father and her homeland. While fleeing, she accidentally became the wielder of a cursed sword and ends up joining Nirvana. Although she struggles to master the power of the cursed sword, she finds a new place for herself supported by her companions.
